text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- People and political parties accuse (ETA's political wing) HB of being ETA's accomplice.
- Governments throughout the world show solidarity with Spain.
EL MUNDO
- Ajuria Enea said HB leaders responsible for the murder.
- Three proposals to isolate HB.
ABC
- (Victim's village) Ermua: image of grief.
CINCO DIAS
- We want peace - Citiziens call for justice
- Investment trusts, to overflow
- (Barcelona's mayor) Maragal: we want three tenths of V.A.T. payments and 10 percent of fuel taxes.
- Economic overheating or a simple pick-up?
EXPANSION
- Spain asks European partners for changes in cohesion funds so it will not lose 1.3 trillion pesetas.
- The murder of the young politician Miguel Angel Blanco marks a before and after in the Basque country.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- (Spanish State tv) RTVE is planning to cut 1,300 members of staff.
- Interest rate reduction is the only factor making housing cheaper.
- Unions and employers to participate in today's mourning.
